video_title: POSTGAME SOUND: ATLANTA HAWKS VS. ORLANDO MAGIC | COACH SWEENEY, WENDELL CARTER JR. & PAOLO BANCHERO

quotes.quote: we lost focus of taking out the three-point line, you know, guys like CJ, Nikil, those guys are hunting threes and we weren't doing a really good job of that early on.
